::: {.callout-note appearance="simple"}
本頁以 ONT 原廠 [price list](https://store.nanoporetech.com/priceList.html) 匯出的 CSV 為價格來源，搭配本 repo 維護的產品註解表，依核酸類型、設備類型與用途篩選建議的 sequencing kit 與 flow cell。  
價格僅供規劃參考，正式採購仍以原廠或代理商 quote 為準。
:::

## 互動篩選

<div class="selector-panel">
  <label>

## 判讀提示

| 情境 | 直觀選擇 |
|:---|:---|
| MinION/GridION 上做一般 DNA / metagenomics | DNA kit + `FLO-MIN114` |
| MinION/GridION 上做 cDNA-PCR transcript sequencing | `SQK-PCB114.24` 或 `SQK-PCS114` + `FLO-MIN114` |
| MinION/GridION 上做 direct RNA | `SQK-DRB004.24` 或 `SQK-RNA004` + `FLO-MIN004RA` |
| PromethION 上做 DNA | DNA kit + `FLO-PRO114M` |
| PromethION 上做 direct RNA | direct RNA kit + `FLO-PRO004RA` |
| RNA / cDNA 新流程測試 | 先用本頁確認 kit 與 flow cell；control / auxiliary reagent 另依 SOP 或採購清單確認 |

<details class="maintenance-details">
<summary>資料來源與維護</summary>

| 檔案 | 用途 | 何時更新 |
|:---|:---|:---|
| `data/ont_pricelist.csv` | 原廠 price list raw export，保留完整產品清單與價格 | 原廠價格或產品清單更新時，直接用新版 CSV 覆蓋 |
| `data/ont_product_annotations.csv` | 本站自訂註解：只讓需要決策的 kit 與 flow cell 進入選擇器 | 新增 kit、修改判斷規則或補 SOP 連結時更新 |
| `data/ont_selector_data.js` | 由前兩個 CSV 產生的網頁資料檔，只包含 sequencing kit 與 flow cell | 更新 CSV 後用 script 重新產生 |

</details>

```{=html}

<script src="data/ont_selector_data.js"></script>
<script>
function splitValues(value) {
  return (value || "")
    .split(";")
    .map(item => item.trim())
    .filter(Boolean);
}

function uniqueSorted(values) {
  return [...new Set(values.filter(Boolean))].sort((a, b) => a.localeCompare(b));
}

function addOptions(select, values) {
  values.forEach(value => {
    const option = document.createElement("option");
    option.value = value;
    option.textContent = value;
    select.appendChild(option);
  });
}

function cell(text, className = "") {
  const td = document.createElement("td");
  td.textContent = text || "";
  if (className) td.className = className;
  return td;
}

function linkCell(record) {
  const td = document.createElement("td");
  if (record.page) {
    const link = document.createElement("a");
    link.href = record.page.replace(".qmd", ".html");
    link.textContent = record.ProductName || record.sku;
    td.appendChild(link);
  } else {
    td.textContent = record.ProductName || "";
  }
  return td;
}

function matchesMultiValue(fieldValue, selected) {
  if (!selected) return true;
  const values = splitValues(fieldValue);
  return values.includes(selected);
}

function matchesMultiplex(fieldValue, selected) {
  if (!selected) return true;
  return fieldValue === selected || fieldValue === "na";
}

function roleLabel(role) {
  const labels = {
    sequencing_kit: "Sequencing kit",
    flow_cell: "Flow cell"
  };
  return labels[role] || role;
}

function renderRecommendationCards(records, container) {
  container.replaceChildren();
  if (records.length === 0) {
    const empty = document.createElement("div");
    empty.className = "empty-result";
    empty.textContent = "目前沒有完全符合的組合。請先放寬用途或 multiplex 條件，或檢查 annotation 是否需要新增此情境。";
    container.appendChild(empty);
    return;
  }

  const groups = [
    ["sequencing_kit", "建議 kit"],
    ["flow_cell", "搭配 flow cell"]
  ];

  groups.forEach(([role, title]) => {
    const items = records.filter(row => row.role === role);
    if (items.length === 0) return;

    const card = document.createElement("section");
    card.className = "recommendation-card";
    const heading = document.createElement("h3");
    heading.textContent = title;
    const list = document.createElement("ul");

    items.forEach(row => {
      const item = document.createElement("li");
      const sku = document.createElement("span");
      sku.className = "sku";
      sku.textContent = row.sku;
      const price = document.createElement("span");
      price.className = "price";
      price.textContent = row.ListPrice ? ` (${row.ListPrice})` : "";
      item.append(sku, document.createTextNode(` - ${row.ProductName || row.library_type}`), price);
      list.appendChild(item);
    });

    card.append(heading, list);
    container.appendChild(card);
  });
}

function loadSelector() {
  const records = (window.ONT_SELECTOR_DATA && window.ONT_SELECTOR_DATA.records) || [];
  const nucleicSelect = document.getElementById("filter-nucleic");
  const deviceSelect = document.getElementById("filter-device");
  const applicationSelect = document.getElementById("filter-application");
  const multiplexSelect = document.getElementById("filter-multiplex");
  const prioritySelect = document.getElementById("filter-priority");
  const tbody = document.querySelector("#selector-table tbody");
  const summary = document.getElementById("selector-summary");
  const cards = document.getElementById("recommendation-cards");

  if (records.length === 0) {
    summary.textContent = "資料載入失敗：data/ont_selector_data.js 沒有可用資料。";
    return;
  }

  addOptions(nucleicSelect, uniqueSorted(records.flatMap(row => splitValues(row.nucleic_acid))));
  addOptions(deviceSelect, uniqueSorted(records.flatMap(row => splitValues(row.device_class))));
  addOptions(
    applicationSelect,
    uniqueSorted(
      records
        .filter(row => row.role === "sequencing_kit")
        .flatMap(row => splitValues(row.application))
    )
  );

  function render() {
    const filtered = records.filter(row => {
      const applicationMatches = row.role === "flow_cell"
        ? true
        : matchesMultiValue(row.application, applicationSelect.value);
      return matchesMultiValue(row.nucleic_acid, nucleicSelect.value)
        && matchesMultiValue(row.device_class, deviceSelect.value)
        && applicationMatches
        && matchesMultiplex(row.multiplex, multiplexSelect.value)
        && (!prioritySelect.value || row.priority === prioritySelect.value);
    });

    tbody.replaceChildren();
    renderRecommendationCards(filtered, cards);
    filtered.forEach(row => {
      const tr = document.createElement("tr");
      const roleTd = document.createElement("td");
      const roleSpan = document.createElement("span");
      roleSpan.className = "role-pill";
      roleSpan.textContent = roleLabel(row.role);
      roleTd.appendChild(roleSpan);
      tr.append(
        roleTd,
        cell(row.sku),
        linkCell(row),
        cell(row.nucleic_acid),
        cell(row.library_type),
        cell(row.sample_count),
        cell(row.device_class),
        cell(row.flow_cell_sku),
        cell(row.application),
        cell(row.ListPrice, "price-cell"),
        cell(row.notes)
      );
      tbody.appendChild(tr);
    });
    summary.textContent = `目前顯示 ${filtered.length} / ${records.length} 個已註解產品。`;
  }

  [nucleicSelect, deviceSelect, applicationSelect, multiplexSelect, prioritySelect]
    .forEach(select => select.addEventListener("change", render));
  render();
}

loadSelector();
</script>
```
